title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Flying domestic in NZ with kids? Learn Air NZ tips, baggage and seating options for a stress-free family flight
intro: As a parent, flying domestic in NZ with kids can be a daunting task, especially when it comes to navigating Air NZ's baggage allowance and seating options. With prices starting from $49 for a one-way ticket from Auckland to Wellington, it's essential to plan ahead to ensure a smooth journey. In this article, we'll explore the ins and outs of flying domestic with kids in NZ

sections.heading: Air NZ Domestic Flights with Kids
sections.body: Air NZ offers a range of domestic flights connecting major cities like Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, and Queenstown. When booking, consider the drive time to the airport, with Auckland Airport being approximately 30 minutes from the city centre, while Wellington Airport is about 15 minutes from the city centre.

sections.heading: Family Seating Options
list: Choose a Skycouch: from $169 per person
Opt for Economy or Premium Economy: from $49 and $129 per person respectively

sections.heading: Baggage Allowance
sections.body: Air NZ's domestic baggage allowance includes one checked bag up to 23kg, with additional bags incurring a fee of $20 per bag. Consider packing lightly to avoid extra costs, especially if you're flying from Queenstown to Christchurch, a short 1-hour flight.

sections.heading: Tips for Flying with Kids
list: Book a morning flight to avoid delays
Pack entertainment for the kids, such as tablets or colouring books
Consider booking a flight with a meal service to save time and money

sections.heading: Accommodation Options
sections.body: Once you've arrived at your destination, consider booking a family-friendly accommodation, such as a campervan or apartment. For example, a 2-bedroom apartment in Queenstown costs around $250 per night, while a campervan rental starts from $120 per day.
